title: Noteboard

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.description: Write down what you want to remember. Notes stay on this device.

delete.title: Delete this note?
delete.message: The note will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.

errors.save: The note could not be saved on this device. Try again.
errors.delete: The note could not be deleted. Try again.

privacy: These notes are never shared or included in the QR code.

noMatch.title: No notes match
noMatch.description: Try another word or another tag.

lock.lockedSubtitle: Your notes are locked. Enter the password to read them.

set.title: Set a Noteboard password
set.warning: If you forget this password, nobody can recover your notes, not even you. Write it down somewhere safe.
set.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
set.failed: The notes could not be locked. Nothing was changed.

remove.title: Remove the Noteboard password
remove.message: Your notes go back to plain text on this device.
